name: bdf_get_oat_yield
description:
French government bond (OAT) yield in percent, monthly: every bond_term reads the same ECB series, IRS.M.FR.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z (France long-term, about 10-year, interest rate for convergence purposes), so the term does not change the result.
Returns: series_code, label, unit, frequency (always reported as % and Daily), observation_count and observations (date, value).
Inputs (* required): bond_term* (2y, 5y, 10y, 30y; schema default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For euro area yield-curve yields by maturity use ecb_get_bond_yield. Despite the bdf_ name, data comes from the legacy ECB statistical web service (sdw-wsrest.ecb.europa.eu), no API key; the ecb_ tools read the same ECB data from the current ECB Data Portal API.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "recent_periods": 12}
